sentences.text: 2. This appeal is preferred by the claimant assailing the Judgment and Award dated 03.04.2021 in MVC No.926/2015 on the file of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.XV, Vijayapura, dismissing the claim petition.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.XV, Vijayapura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. It is the case of the claimant that on 12.04.2015 at about 9.00 p.m., the claimant was travelling in an Autorickshaw bearing No.KA-32/A-1404 from Shivanagi towards Ankalagi NC:
2026:KHC-K:1100 HC-KAR side and at that time, the lorry bearing No. KA-01/C-9225 came from opposite side, dashed to the Autorickshaw and on account of the same, claimant sustained grievous injuries.
Hence, claimant preferred MVC No.926/2015 before the Tribunal.
4. The claim petition was contested by the respondents.
The Tribunal after considering the material on record, by its Judgment and Award dated 03.04.2021, dismissed the claim petition.
Feeling aggrieved by the same, claimant has preferred this appeal.

Satih S/O Shivappa Hadpad vs A. Mothilal Arumgugam And Anr on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71274874/
2 5.

entities.text: Shivappa Hadpad vs A. Mothilal Arumgugam And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having taken note of the submissions made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties, the Tribunal, particularly taking into consideration that the RTO has conducted the motor vehicle inspection on 24.04.2015 after lapse of 12 days and therefore arrived at the conclusion that as there was no damage to the lorry and as such, dismissed the claim petition.
The said finding requires to be interfered with by looking into the spot mahazar at Ex.P3 which reflects the involvement of the vehicle in question.

In that view of the matter, I am of the view that, it is a fit case to remand the NC:
2026:KHC-K:1100 HC-KAR matter to the Tribunal to assess the compensation that may be paid to the claimant in accordance with law.

6. In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The appeal is allowed in part.

(ii) The Judgment and Award dated 03.04.2021 in MVC No.926/2015 on the file of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.XV, Vijayapura, is hereby set aside and the matter is remanded to the Tribunal for assessment of compensation in accordance with law.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.XV, Vijayapura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: (iii) In order to avoid delay, as parties are represented by their learned counsel in this appeal, parties are directed to appear before the concerned MACT at 11.00 a.m. on 04.03.2026.
(iv) All contentions of the parties are kept open.

Sd/-
